label: Bitrate Starve
blurb: The way a live stream at too low a bitrate falls apart, driven by what actually happens in the footage. Calm moments stay clean; the instant the picture changes a lot, a cut, a whip pan, an explosion, confetti, the encoder runs out of bits and the frame breaks into flat macroblocks with colour smearing past the edges, then sharpens back up block by block as the bits catch up. When it runs dry completely it drops frames and the last one hangs. It replays a real encoder's bit budget, so busy footage stays rough and quiet footage heals.
